description: Prompt-injection screen for text or a web page an agent is about to read: finds instruction overrides (many languages and obfuscated spellings), fake system or role markers, jailbreak personas, data-exfiltration links, requests for keys or seed phrases, tool, shell, or payment hijacks, and hidden content (invisible Unicode smuggling, zero-width and bidi characters, HTML comments, hidden elements, base64). Returns a verdict, 0-100 risk score, findings, and cleaned text. Not charged on bad input. Paid via x402; see list_prices.

text.description: Text to check, up to 50,000 characters.

url.description: Or a web page URL to fetch and check, including its hidden parts.

name: check_prompt_injection
title: Prompt-injection check: scans text or a web page for hidden instructions before an agent reads it
